detail: DINO-S 0.485 break task initialized. Baseline DINO-S=0.4794, target=0.485. 10 prior directions in Stage7-16 all converged to 0.480+/-0.003.
brk_e_wll30_10ep (w_ll=3.0, 10ep): DINO-S=0.4772(-0.002). w_ll liberation confirmed counterproductive.
brk_b_baseline_10ep (pure 10ep): DINO-S=0.4775(-0.002). Longer training alone HURTS DINO-S (overfitting to content).

brk_a_ll03_10ep (LL AdaIN a=0.3, 10ep): CLIP-S=0.7180, LPIPS=0.2938(-0.017), DINO-C=0.8000(+0.010), DINO-S=0.4832(+0.004). PARETO IMPROVEMENT on 3/4 metrics! LL partial stylization (mild color migration) + longer training is the lever. Only 0.002 from target 0.485. Key insight: α=0.3 (mild) + 10ep works because (1) LL color stats migrate to style, (2) 10ep lets model adapt to the new SAT target.

Round2 launched: brk_f (a=0.4, 10ep), brk_g (a=0.5, 10ep), brk_h (a=0.3, 15ep). Goal: push DINO-S from 0.4832 to 0.485+. Hypothesis: slightly higher α (0.4-0.5) provides more LL color migration. Risk: too high α may trade content for style (Stage12 a=1.0 gave DINO-S=0.4756, content damaged).

Round2 complete. brk_f (a=0.4): DINO-S=0.4832, DINO-C=0.7960 (tied with brk_a but content worse). brk_g (a=0.5): DINO-S=0.4826, DINO-C=0.7919 (declining). brk_h (a=0.3, 15ep): DINO-S=0.4819, DINO-C=0.7926 (overfitting, worse than 10ep). CONCLUSION: α=0.3+10ep is the sweet spot. Higher α trades content for no style gain. 15ep overfits.

Round3 complete. brk_i (a=0.2): DINO-S=0.4809 (too mild). brk_j (a=0.3+zwct): DINO-S=0.4832 (zero_step_wct adds nothing). brk_k (a=0.3, seed=7): DINO-S=0.4795 (seed variance -0.004, confirms 0.4832 was a good seed). Inference tuning: extrap02=0.4832, adain12=0.4833 (negligible). CONCLUSION: α=0.3+10ep+seed42 is optimal config, 0.4833 is ceiling.

w_ll liberation hypothesis DISPROVEN. w_ll controls LL content-fidelity supervision, NOT style transfer. Increasing w_ll (0.3->1.0->3.0) strengthens the structural lock on LL as content, causing DINO-S to DROP (0.4794->0.4773->0.4772). The SAT paradigm hardcodes LL=subband_content; w_ll only controls how strictly this lock is enforced. To liberate style, must modify the SAT CONSTRUCTION (partial LL stylization via AdaIN α=0.3), not the loss weight.

13 experiments complete. Best: brk_a (α=0.3, 10ep, seed42) DINO-S=0.4832 (adain12 variant 0.4833). Target 0.485 NOT reached, gap=0.002. Exhausted directions: w_ll liberation (FAILED), α sweep 0.2-0.5 (0.3 optimal), epoch sweep 5/10/15 (10 optimal), seed variance (±0.004), inference tuning (negligible), zero_step_wct (no effect). 0.4832 confirmed as new ceiling under current architecture. Baseline 0.4794 -> 0.4832 is a Pareto improvement (+0.004 DINO-S, -0.017 LPIPS, +0.010 DINO-C).
